name: Halibut

raw.description: Fish, halibut, Atlantic and Pacific, raw

notes: Cooked half missing: 'Fish, halibut, Atlantic and Pacific, cooked, dry heat' never surfaced in 4 queries. Only FNDDS 'Fish, halibut' (2706260) came back, and its 7.79 g carbs show it is a breaded/fried average, so it was rejected. Cooked plain halibut is roughly raw x1.28 (about 117 kcal / 23.8 P / 1.7 F per 100 g) if a manual fill is ever wanted.
